description: Credit-risk engine (IFRS 9 / HKFRS 9). Compute 12-month, lifetime, and staged expected credit loss, PD/LGD/EAD, provision matrices, hazard rates, and CVA/DVA. Use this for impairment, fair-value credit adjustment, and loan-loss provisioning; for the credit component of a specific convertible bond use calculate_convertible_bond, and for liquidity, control or marketability discounts rather than credit loss use calculate_fair_value_adjustment. Methods: ecl_12m: ead, pd, lgd; ecl_lifetime: ead, pd_lifetime, lgd; ecl_staged: ead, pd_12m, pd_lifetime, lgd, stage; provision_matrix: receivables_ageing, loss_rates; pd_from_spread: credit_spread, recovery, tenor_years; cumulative_pd: annual_pd, years; hazard: hazard_rate, tenor_years; cva_dva: exposure_profile, pd, lgd, discount_rate. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

credit_spread.description: Credit spread over the risk-free rate (decimal).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%); pre-tax when method=viu_pre_tax.

ead.description: Exposure at default in currency units.

hazard_rate.description: Default hazard rate as a decimal.

lgd.description: Loss given default in [0,1] (1 - recovery rate).

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

pd.description: Probability of default over the horizon, in [0,1].

years.description: Number of projection years n; equal len(cash_flows) when both are supplied.

name: calculate_credit_loss

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Credit loss and impairment
